architecture_tested: Fractional age + current non-elite endpoints + monotone elite youth taper.

candidate_definitions.continuous_linear: Fractional age; elite premium linear from age 21 to 25.
candidate_definitions.continuous_smoothstep: Fractional age; elite premium cubic smoothstep from age 21 to 25.
candidate_definitions.continuous_quadratic: Fractional age; elite premium quadratic from age 21 to 25.

interpretation_boundary: Observed market changes remain confounded by football news and changing historical roles. This audit is strongest as a structural discontinuity test. Paired error improvement is supporting evidence, not causal proof of the exact age curve.
